src/nip5d-transport.ts.name: Per-napplet channel
src/nip5d-transport.ts.description: Accepts one hello with one message port per frame, routes messages only from that port, and revokes the napplet on any sign of replacement.

src/random-uuid.ts.name: Unguessable IDs
src/random-uuid.ts.description: Makes random IDs with the browser's built-in secure ID maker, building one from secure random bytes when that is missing, and fails if neither is available.
